;Disasters and accidents
*A [[Cirrus SR22]] crashes into a house in [[Upland, California]], killing the pilot. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2019-11-07/aircraft-crashes-into-home-in-upland-sparking-fire-officials-say (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in Malaysia]]
**Five [[Malaysians|Malaysian]] men are sentenced to six months in jail, fined, and caned for "attempting gay sex". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-lgbt/malaysia-sentences-five-men-to-jail-caning-and-fines-for-gay-sex-idUSKBN1XH197 (Reuters)]
*The [[International Criminal Court]] sentences [[Bosco Ntaganda]] to 30 years in prison for war crimes as leader of the [[National Congress for the Defence of the People]] which operated in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/icc-set-sentence-congolese-rebel-chief-bosco-ntaganda-191107065841913.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]]
**The mayor of [[Vinto]], Patricia Arce of the ruling [[Movement for Socialism (Bolivia)|MAS]] party, is attacked by opposition protesters who dragged her through the streets barefoot, covered her in red paint and forcibly cut her hair. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50332167 (BBC News)]
**Limbert Guzman, a 20-year-old student, is killed following clashes between supporters and opponents of [[President of Bolivia|Bolivian President]] [[Evo Morales]]. [https://www.voanews.com/americas/bolivia-clashes-third-person-killed-disputed-election (Voice of America)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Mauritian general election]]
**Citizens of [[Mauritius]] cast their vote in the country's latest [[Elections in Mauritius|parliamentary election]]. [[Militant Socialist Movement]], led by incumbent [[Prime Minister of Mauritius|Prime Minister]] [[Pravind Jugnauth]] wins a huge majority securing the re-election. [https://www.foreignbrief.com/daily-news/indian-ocean-island-nation-of-mauritius-heads-to-the-polls-for-parliamentary-election/ (Foreign Brief)] [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/11/08/world/africa/08reuters-mauritius-election.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mauritius-election/mauritius-starts-counting-votes-after-parliamentary-election-idUSKBN1XI177 (Reuters)]
